# Third-party browser libraries

Copied unmodified from npm by `npm run vendor` (see `app/package.json`), so the web app
works without a bundler.

| File | Package | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `livekit-client.umd.js` | livekit-client | 2.22.3 | Apache-2.0 | <https://github.com/livekit/client-sdk-js> |
| `jsQR.js` | jsqr | 1.4.0 | Apache-2.0 | <https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR> |
| `qrcode-generator.js` | qrcode-generator | 1.4.4 | MIT | <https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator> |

Each library remains under its own license, available at its source repository.
